contract.goal: Stop structurally incomplete predicted endpoints from becoming confident candidate literature relations.
contract.hypothesis: The strict decoder emits a prefix when a conflicting orphan I token follows it. Drop that entire prefix; also abstain when an entity boundary splits an alphanumeric/underscore word. These structural rules have no task-name lists, calibrated confidence threshold or reference-label input.
contract.labels: AI reference labels; same-session source review. No annotation mutations or human-label prerequisite.
contract.trainCheck: All58 training reference BIO sequences must retain all678 exact entities and abstain from none; source annotations are not changed to make this check pass.
contract.replay: Use sealed47 logits to reproduce frozen46 argmax. Conservative entities must be a subset. Reuse only exact identical candidate inputs and cached frozen46 RE labels; absent/changed inputs fail. Rejected candidates are abstentions, never NO_RELATION or accepted facts.
contract.evaluation: Predeclare one rule, replay all16 already-exposed dev documents and all7 complete pipeline documents. Compare with original46 and frozen42; do not search word lists, thresholds, checkpoints or evaluate reserved test19.
contract.guards: Inherited pipeline P/F1/recall guards against42 and support/coverage minima; additionally NER micro F1 and DATASET recall nonregression against46. Successful engineering does not automatically promote.
